_how_to_edit: Each category lists the scrapbook numbers it covers: the number in brackets at the start of a master's file name, for example (04).
Entries with the same name are shown together, with their 'sub' names indented underneath. To split Roof later, give each roof number its own entry with name Roof and a sub name.
Masters whose number is not listed are shown under Other. After saving this file, reload the Detail Manager page.
If this file has a mistake, Detail Manager uses its built-in list and notes it under Diagnostics.
